question: Would you feel safe living next to a US bomber base, yes or no?

lines.text: Police have arrested several men on suspicion of explosives offences near RAF Fairford, a base used by US bombers.
lines.note: Gloucestershire Police via ITV News, Reuters, ABC News, 27 Sep

lines.text: Homes in the nearby village of Whelford were evacuated this morning, after police declared a major incident.
lines.note: Gloucestershire Police statement via ITV, ABC

lines.text: Residents were taken to a nearby leisure centre. Armed police are guarding a cordon.
The Army's bomb disposal team has been examining vehicles in the area.
Gloucestershire Police say: we believe this incident is contained.
lines.note: Gloucestershire Police via ITV News and ABC News, verbatim

scene.quote: we believe this incident is contained

lines.text: Sky News reports security at the base had already been stepped up before the arrests.
ABC News says US B-52 and B-1 bombers have flown from Fairford during the Iran war, which began in February.
lines.note: ABC News; Ynetnews (limited strike missions against Iranian targets)

lines.text: Police have not said whether the arrests are linked to the base. A US Air Force spokesperson says they remain vigilant.
lines.note: ABC News, The Week (no link confirmed); USAF spokesperson via Ynetnews

lines.text: So, would you feel safe living next to a US bomber base, yes or no?
